findings.claim: 2Q26 ATM 前五大客戶約占淨營收 44%（1Q26 為 43%），單一客戶占比超過 10%；未指名客戶，也未提第二供應商或自製。
findings.source: ASE Technology Holding 2Q26 財報新聞稿（ycharts/PRN 轉載）
findings.excerpt: Our five largest customers together accounted for approximately 44% of our total net revenues in 2Q26, compared to 43% in 1Q26. One customer accounted for more than 10% of our total net revenues in 2Q26.

findings.claim: 2Q26 EMS 口徑前五大客戶約占淨營收 58%，低於 1Q26 的 64%，單一客戶超過 10%。
findings.source: ASE Technology Holding 2Q26 財報新聞稿（ycharts/PRN 轉載）
findings.excerpt: Our five largest customers together accounted for approximately 58% of our total net revenues in 2Q26, compared to 64% in 1Q26.

note: 三次搜尋未找到任何報導指出最大客戶導入第二供應商或將封測自製；搜尋結果只有客戶集中度數字與台積電 CoWoS 外溢訂單的受惠報導（日月光為承接方，非被分流方）。第二供應商/自製證據：none。
